Great cafe and amazing service from Teddy
Oct 2026 • Solo
I recently visited this cafe and had a really pleasant experience. The atmosphere was cozy and clean, the music was at a comfortable volume, and the staff made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. I ordered a cappuccino and a meal, and everything was fresh, tasty, and well presented. The coffee was rich and perfectly made.
 
A special thank you to our waiter, Teddy. He was friendly, polite, and very professional. He gave great recommendations, answered all our questions, and made sure we had everything we needed without being intrusive. Even when the cafe got busy, he stayed calm, quick, and attentive. His positive attitude really made the visit memorable.
 
Overall, I highly recommend this cafe. If you go, ask for Teddy — he will take great care of you. 5/5 stars.
